visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with bleached blonde hair and a cream-colored top with ruffled sleeves stands against a dark brown wooden door, smiling and holding her hands together in a prayer gesture. (2) She presents a gold and yellow package of 'Quality 1st Derma Laser 100' face masks to the camera. (3) A screen-in-screen overlay appears at the bottom, showing her previously posted Reels of the same product while she points to it. (4) The scene cuts to a close-up of her face wearing a white face mask on her nose and cheeks; she holds up three fingers to signify three minutes. (5) Side-by-side 'Before' and 'After' close-up shots of her eye area are shown to demonstrate skin brightness. (6) The camera zooms in on award labels and 'Number 1' stickers on the product packaging. (7) A hand picks up the gold mask packet from a dense retail shelf at a store with a sign mentioning 'matsukiyo'. (8) The woman introduces a new product in a red and silver package labeled 'Eye Sheet'. (9) She points at her lower eyelid while holding the red packet. (10) A close-up shows the inside of the eye mask packet, which is filled with white patches and liquid essence. (11) A hand squeezes the liquid out of the packet to demonstrate its abundance. (12) She is now wearing a grey knit sweater and applies the white crescent-shaped eye patches under her eyes. (13) A series of quick cuts shows her wearing the eye patches while brushing her teeth and later peeling them off to reveal moisturized skin. (14) She holds two eye mask packets, one used and crumpled and one new, while explaining her repurchasing habit. (15) The product is shown in a clean bathroom setting next to a yellow rubber duck and a book. (16) A panning shot reveals a wide variety of colorful 'Quality 1st' products on a store shelf. (17) Back in front of the wooden door, she holds both the face mask and the eye mask packets, smiling and gesturing for viewers to buy them.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with short, bleached blonde hair. She wears a cream-colored long-sleeve top with ruffled cuffs initially, then switches to a grey textured knit sweater during the application sequence.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a dark brown wooden door in an indoor setting. Other backgrounds include a dense retail shelf in a Japanese drugstore (Matsukiyo), a bathroom counter with a yellow rubber duck, and a digital screen recording overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking in a very energetic and friendly tone in Mandarin, introducing a facial mask. The speech rate is high, and the articulation is very clear. The background music is an upbeat, major-key pop track with a strong electronic drum beat and bright synthesizer pads. (2) As the speaker transitions into describing the product's effectiveness and award history, her pitch shows significant variability, emphasizing key selling points. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) The speaker shifts the focus to a new eye mask product. Her voice remains high-arousal and positive. No significant environmental or incidental noises are present, indicating a high-quality studio recording or clean post-production. (4) The narration continues with a detailed explanation of the eye patches' ingredients and usage while the BGM maintains the energetic atmosphere. The vocal dominance is high as she provides personal testimony about the product. (5) The recording concludes with a final recommendation and information about where to purchase the masks, maintaining the upbeat vocal and musical delivery until the end.
